description: A shell script for setting up Apple App Store Connect API key credentials in macOS Keychain and optionally updating environment files for Fastlane.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: upsert_env_line
methods.description: Updates or inserts a line in an environment file with a given key and value.

methods.name: delete_env_line
methods.description: Removes a line with a specific key from an environment file.
